chapter_title_bn: ভারত ও বিশ্বের প্রথম, আবিষ্কার ও নোবেল পুরস্কার

questions.question: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile River in Africa is the longest river in the world, spanning about 6,650 km.

questions.question: Who was the first President of Independent India?
questions.question_bn: স্বাধীন ভারতের প্রথম রাষ্ট্রপতি কে ছিলেন?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the first President of the Republic of India from 1950 to 1962.

questions.question: Which layer of the atmosphere protects Earth from harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation?
questions.question_bn: বায়ুমণ্ডলের কোন স্তর পৃথিবীকে ক্ষতিকারক অতিবেগুনি রশ্মি থেকে রক্ষা করে?
questions.explanation: The Ozone layer located in the stratosphere absorbs the majority of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

questions.question: Which is the highest peak in the world?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas (8,848.86 m).

questions.question: Who was the architect and Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?
questions.question_bn: ভারতীয় সংবিধানের খসড়া কমিটির সভাপতি ও প্রধান রূপকার কে ছিলেন?
options: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar (ড. বি. আর. আম্বেদকর)
questions.explanation: Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar is recognized as the chief architect of the Constitution of India.
